manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}{R}, plus enough mana to cast the additional spell if needed
notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cast an additional instant or sorcery, or an opponent is casting one.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting that spell.
Cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, copying Fork, with the copy targeting Fork.
Resolve the copy of Fork, copying the original Fork, with the copy targeting the original Fork.
Repeat step 4.
